summary: FromSoftware's modern-ninja action game for Xbox 360 and Windows.

entries.title: Ninja Blade
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC version where legally owned

emulation.emulator: Native Windows or Xenia where legal and stable
emulation.notes: Use native Windows if owned; Xbox 360 emulation is a fallback for preservation.

primary.why: Ninja Blade released for Xbox 360 in 2009, then Windows later in 2009 and through select retail/digital routes. Windows is the highest-fidelity route if you already own or can legally access it, though the Steam listing is no longer active.
primary.how_to_play: Play a legally owned Windows copy natively; use the Xbox 360 version if PC access is unavailable.

entries.remaster_caveats: Steam availability changed in 2022; preserve owned PC copies or use Xbox 360 hardware.
